next_step_summary: Product owner redirected evaluation from the ten-case synthetic provider comparison to one real rental contract at a time. PR #271 adds a local Windows runner that lets the user choose exactly one PDF and does not expose model selection. For text-layer PDFs, extraction stays local; high-risk identity zones are removed, the existing deterministic text redactor is applied, and a residual-PII/usability gate must pass before any Gemini call. Image-only/scanned PDFs fail closed and require a future approved OCR path. Provider selection is automatic reactive failover gemini-3.6-flash -> gemini-3.7-flash -> gemini-3.5-flash; authentication/configuration failures abort. No 3.8 route is added. After PR #271 validation/merge, run the chosen real text-layer contract once and inspect the sanitized structured report and attempt ledger. Raw PDFs, raw extracted text and recoverable PII remain local and must not be committed or written to the report.
